work.title: Kiev Missal
work.edition: Machine translation (gpt-6.1-sol, Patristica, 2026-10-29) of: Kiev Missal (Kiev Folia, Glagolitic, 10th c.): masses of a Latin-rite sacramentary in Slavonic; TOROT (Tromsø Old Russian and OCS Treebank), Syntacticus release 20230428, Cyrillic transcription.

paragraphs.text: On the twelfth day: Clement

O God, who gladden us with the yearly celebration of blessed Clement, your martyr and pope, mercifully grant that we may imitate the strength of the martyrdom of him whose feast we honor. Through our Lord.
Over the offerings
Sanctify, Lord, the offered [?], and through the intercession of blessed Clement, your martyr, cleanse us through these from the stains of our sins. Through our Lord.
Preface: It is right

Eternal God, as we honor the feast of venerable Clement, priest and martyr, who was worthy to be a companion of your blessed apostle Peter in religious life, his disciple in confessing the faith, his deputy in office, and his successor in martyrdom. Through Christ our Lord.
After Communion
Filled with the draught of the holy body and most precious blood, we ask you, Lord our God, that we may embrace true redemption in place of the merciful promises we bear. Through our Lord.
On the same day: Felicity
Grant us, we ask you, almighty God, united prayer for the sake of blessed Felicity, your martyr, and protect us for her sake. Through our Lord.
Over the offerings
Look mercifully upon the offerings of your people, and make us, who honor the saints with this celebration, joyful in eternal life.
After Communion
We humbly pray to you, almighty God: through the prayers of your saints, be present yourself, and let your gift dwell within us, and establish our times in righteousness. Through our Lord.
Masses for every day throughout the course of the whole year

O God, who had great mercy on your creation and, after your wrath, chose to become incarnate for the salvation of humankind, and in your goodwill toward us, strengthen our hearts and enlighten us with your mercy. Through our Lord.
Over the offerings
Be near us, Lord, we ask you, and hear our prayer. So that we may gain confidence in our deeds. And in love we bring this gift to you. Through the Lord.
PREFACE:

Eternal God, we ask and pray for your heavenly power, that with your heavenly ones you may make us worthy, and mercifully grant us the eternal gifts of yours for which we long. Through Christ our Lord. Through whom
AFTER COMMUNION:
We ask you, Lord, to grant us that, receiving your holy communion, we may be worthy of your cleansing. And may faith in you grow within us. Through our Lord Jesus.
MASS 2. ON THE SAME SUBJECT:
We ask you, almighty, eternal God: look upon our prayer and cleanse our innermost parts, which our sins parch [?], and deliver us by your mercy. Through our Lord.
OVER THE OFFERINGS:
We ask you, Lord, to accept this offering presented to you, which you have blessed for our salvation. Through our Lord.
PREFACE: UP TO

Eternal God, may we hold fast to you and ask for your mercy. You have called us, Lord; set us right and cleanse us, not because of our deeds, but because of the promise you have made to us, so that with our souls, bodies, and minds we may be able to receive your commandments, which you have sent to us. Through Christ our Lord, through whom we magnify [?].
AFTER COMMUNION:
We pray to you, Lord, that your holy communion, which we have received, may cleanse us of our sins and lead us to heavenly love. Through our Lord.
MASS 3. ON THE SAME SUBJECT:
We ask you, almighty God: as we are afflicted by our sins, cleanse us by your mercy of all our evils. Through the Lord.
OVER THE OFFERINGS:
We ask you, Lord, to accept this offering presented to you for human redemption, and grant us health. And cleanse our souls and bodies, and accept our prayer. Through the Lord.
PREFACE: UP TO

Eternal God, you are our life, Lord, for you brought us from nonexistence into being. And when we had fallen, you raised us up again, so that we should not sin against you. All things are yours, in heaven and on earth, Lord. Deliver us yourself from our sins, through Christ the Lord.
AFTER COMMUNION.
Grant us, almighty God, that just as you have fed us with heavenly food, you may also strengthen our life by your power. Through the Lord.
MASS 3. ON THE SAME SUBJECT.

Look with your mercy upon our kingdom, Lord. Do not give what is ours to foreigners, and do not hand us over as captives to pagan nations, for the sake of Christ our Lord, who reigns with the Father and the Holy Spirit.
OVER THE OFFERING.

May the strength of your Church protect us, Lord, which you have fashioned in your own likeness, and which we honor for our healing. For this reason you have brought us the eternal promise. Through our Lord.
PREFACE. IT IS RIGHT...

So that, just as these acts of worship are beloved by you, we too may make ourselves so in our thoughts. And always receive us yourself, Lord, so that we may follow your righteous ways and cleanse ourselves of the devil's works. Through Christ our Lord, through whom the majesty...
AFTER COMMUNION.
May your holy gifts, almighty God, which we now receive, bring us forgiveness and cleansing. And protect us yourself with your eternal help. Through the Lord.
MASS 4. ON THE SAME SUBJECT.
We ask you, Lord, lift our hearts to you from earthly desires, so that we may desire your heavenly things.
OVER THE OFFERING.
Whatever gifts we have are before you, and we ask you to accept them, so that we too may be strong in your love. Through our Lord.
PREFACE. IT IS RIGHT...

Eternal God, may our wickedness not take root within us, but may eternal deliverance always be ours, for our Lord's sake. For he himself led us out of darkness, cleansed us, sealed us, and worthily redeemed us. Through Christ our Lord.
After Communion.
Strengthen our Communion prayers, Lord, with your eternal [?], and grant us your salvation. Through our Lord.
Mass 5. On the same subject.
Lord, take us away from our wickedness, and by your mercy turn us toward your righteousness. Through our Lord.
Over the oblation.

This gift offered to you, Lord, which you yourself have given and made, for the sake of your Church, and for the sake of our life and our passing; and we acknowledge [?] that it is a remedy for eternal life. Through our Lord.
Preface. It is right.

Eternal God. We pray to Jesus Christ, your Son, our Lord, that by his mercy he may protect and save us, for without his mercy we can do nothing. Therefore, for his own sake, we receive gifts and mercy and live in love. Through Christ our Lord.
After Communion.
Having been satisfied by your Communion, Lord, we ask you: save us from all who oppose us. Through our Lord.
Mass for the martyrs.
As we celebrate the feasts of your martyrs, Lord, we pray and ask you: just as you have strengthened them with your heavenly glory, so also receive us in your mercy. Through our Lord.
Over the oblation.
Lord, accept the offering presented to you for the sake of the holy martyrs, and through their prayers and your commandments may your help come swiftly to us. Through our Lord.
After Communion.
Cleanse us, Lord, we ask you, for the sake of your heavenly commandments, and strengthen us so that we may glorify you before your saints with our prayers. Through our Lord.
Mass for all the heavenly powers.

Let us pray. God, who, through the prayers of the blessed Mother of God and ever-virgin Mary, and for the sake of your blessed angels, and all the heavenly powers, and the apostles, and the martyrs, and the holy ascetics, and the pure virgins, and through the prayers of all your saints, have always gladdened us: we ask you, Lord, that, as we celebrate these feasts of theirs, you may in your mercy grant us always, every day, to follow your heavenly powers. Through our Lord.
OVER THE OFFERINGS:

This gift, offered to you, Lord, for the sake of all the holy heavenly powers and all the saints who are yours, and for the sake of the righteous: may it be to your praise; and through their prayers grant us a worthy reward. Through our Lord.
AFTER COMMUNION:

We ask you, Lord: grant us, through the prayers of all the heavenly powers and all your saints, and for the sake of their righteous deeds, through this sacrament we have received, cleanse our hearts of our sins. Through our Lord.
PRAYER 2:

Make us, Lord God, companions of the holy Mother of God and ever-virgin Mary, and worthy of the holy angels and blessed apostles, martyrs, holy ascetics, pure virgins, and all your saints. Through their prayers protect us.
